summary: End-to-end testing of FloForge Hero + Contact lead-capture flow. All 6 backend pytest cases passed and all 6 frontend Playwright UI flows passed including dialog open from all 3 CTAs, validation, invalid email rejection, successful submission with success state + toast, and verified MongoDB persistence via GET /api/leads.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/leads returns 200 - consider returning 201 Created semantically (minor; tests adapted).

Frontend pasted invalid email also relies on browser's type=email validation; explicit toast not always shown depending on form submission path - acceptable but could be hardened with client-side regex check before POST.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True - browsers will reject credentialed CORS with wildcard. Not used currently (no cookies) but should be restricted in production.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handlers.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed leads via API for assertions and one UI-submitted lead (ui_<ts>@example.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend leads CRUD covered by /app/backend/tests/test_leads.py (pytest, parallel xdist). UI flows confirmed via Playwright: Radix Dialog opens from hero-primary-cta, hero-secondary-cta, navbar-cta; form validates empty fields with sonner toast; successful submit shows contact-success and toast; lead is persisted and retrievable via GET /api/leads. Mongo _id is correctly excluded.
